slides.title: The 2027 4Runner starts above $45,000.
slides.body: SR5: $43,490 before destination, $45,085 with it. The hybrid TRD Pro passes $70,000.

slides.title: Heated and power front seats on every grade.
slides.body: Plus Hot Honey paint on the TRD Pro and puddle lamps on the Platinum. Same engines, same frame, same 6,000 lb tow rating.

slides.title: Ask about leftover 2026s.
slides.body: Same truck. At $70,000, cross-shop the Land Cruiser 250. Or buy a used fifth gen.
slides.tag: Make the dealer work for it

end.title: Same truck, bigger sticker.
end.body: My take, and where your 4Runner money goes further.
